w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: You catch fragments by the fire — Nikos telling Everett about you. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
A cart-driver with flour on their sleeves waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.

loss.line: No one is left to pick up the Codex. The village dies out — quietly, the way villages do. The season ends here.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store keeps slipping from its recent high again — evening after evening, lower.
⚠ The store has fallen further still from its recent high.

ladderLines.line: It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
